item.title: World Champion Arsenal Kicks Off 2025/26 UWCL Knockouts vs. OH Leuven
item.description: Reigning UWCL winners Arsenal will kick off the Champions League Round of 16 against Belgian side OH Leuven on Wednesday. The post World Champion Arsenal Kicks Off 2025/26 UWCL Knockouts vs. OH Leuven appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Elizabeth Lemley Wins Olympic Freestyle Moguls Gold as Team USA Goes 1-2
item.description: Team USA skier Elizabeth Lemley claimed Olympic gold in women's freestyle moguls, followed by US teammate Jaelin Kauf at silver. The post Elizabeth Lemley Wins Olympic Freestyle Moguls Gold as Team USA Goes 1-2 appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Laila Edwards Makes Olympic Hockey History in Team USA Win Over Canada
item.description: Laila Edwards became the first Black woman to score a goal for Team USA's Olympic hockey team, sealing a 5-0 statement win over rival Canada. The post Laila Edwards Makes Olympic Hockey History in Team USA Win Over Canada appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Defending Gold Medalist Jakara Anthony Slips in Olympic Freestyle Moguls Final
item.description: Defending Olympic champion Jakara Anthony slipped in her first moguls final jump, dropping to eighth as Team USA's Elizabeth Lemley won gold. The post Defending Gold Medalist Jakara Anthony Slips in Olympic Freestyle Moguls Final appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Iga Świątek Bounces Back to Oust Daria Kasatkina From 2026 Qatar Open
item.description: Despite a strong start from Daria Kasatkina, world No. 2 Iga Świątek rallied to win 5-7, 6-1, 6-1 to advance to the Qatar Open quarterfinals. The post Iga Świątek Bounces Back to Oust Daria Kasatkina From 2026 Qatar Open appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: USA Hockey Makes Winter Olympics History with 5-0 Win Over Rival Canada
item.description: USA Hockey made history with Tuesday's 5-0 group-stage win over rival Canada, marking the defending champions' worst-ever Olympic defeat. The post USA Hockey Makes Winter Olympics History with 5-0 Win Over Rival Canada appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Unrivaled Basketball Stars Hit the Court for 2026 1v1 Tournament
item.description: The Unrivaled 1v1 tournament is back, with stars of the offseason basketball league gearing up to tip off the 2026 competition on Wednesday night. The post Unrivaled Basketball Stars Hit the Court for 2026 1v1 Tournament appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Black History Month Spotlight: Paralympic Trailblazer Bonnie St. John
item.description: US skier Bonnie St. John made history in 1984, becoming the first-ever Black athlete to medal at the Paralympic Winter Games. The post Black History Month Spotlight: Paralympic Trailblazer Bonnie St. John appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Former Pitt Women’s Basketball Players File Lawsuit Over Alleged Coaching Abuse
item.description: Six former Pitt basketball players filed a lawsuit last week, accusing University of Pittsburgh coach Tory Verdi of abusive behavior. The post Former Pitt Women’s Basketball Players File Lawsuit Over Alleged Coaching Abuse appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Myles Garrett Posts Snowboarder Chloe Kim’s 1st Place Olympic Qualifying Run
item.description: NFL star Myles Garrett posted snowboarder girlfriend Chloe Kim's dominant Olympic halfpipe qualifying run in Milano-Cortina on Wednesday. The post Myles Garrett Posts Snowboarder Chloe Kim’s 1st Place Olympic Qualifying Run appeared first on Just Women's Sports.
